to change (something) so that it is right, true, proper, etc. to make (something) correct 纠正某人就是指出某人犯了错误，并给出正确信息。短语“我接受指正”是一种较为正式的表达方式，用来表示你已经认识到自己在某件事上是错的。将（某事）改正，使其正确、真实、恰当等；使（某事）变得正确。 a computer program that corrects [=fixes] spelling errors 一个可以纠正拼写错误的计算机程序 I hate it when she corrects my grammar. 我讨厌她纠正我的语法。 These errors are easily corrected. = These errors can be corrected easily. 这些错误很容易被纠正。 Please correct your essay for punctuation errors.
“I use the title ‘Ms.’ not ‘Mrs.,’” she corrected him.
He quickly corrected himself and said that it cost two dollars, not four.
Correct me if I'm wrong, but I think you owe me another dollar. [=do you owe me another dollar?]
“He's four years old, not five.” “Well, then, I stand corrected.”
I stand corrected. The meeting is on Monday, not Tuesday as I'd thought. 请纠正你的作文中的标点错误。

他很快纠正了自己，说那只要两美元，不是四美元。
如果我说错了请纠正我，但我认为你还欠我一美元。
“他四岁，不是五岁。”“那好，我认错了。”
我认错了。会议是在星期一，不是我以为的星期二。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::04k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::extend eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23
